name: Tennen Kyonyuu Dojikko Nurse! ~Mainichi Ama Ero! Nakadashi Kango Life♪~
original_name: 天然巨乳ドジっ娘ナース！～毎日甘エロッ！中出し看護ライフ♪～
source:
Protagonist Ryuya Yuki is a student who is not quite a lover with his childhood friend and next door neighbor, Mami Mizuse.

One day he eats a boxed lunch that Mami messed up while making and his body collapses.

Mami, crestfallen, confesses her feelings up to that moment. They come to realize each other's feelings and become lovers.

And then Mami dresses up in a nurse's uniform, and the too-sweet lovey nurse lifestyle begins!


[From [url=http://eng.dlsite.com/work/=/product_id/RE040498.html]English DLSite[/url]]
translation:
主人公结城龙也是一名学生，他与青梅竹马的邻居水濑真美并不算是恋人。

有一天，他吃了一份妈妈在做时弄乱的盒饭，他的身体崩溃了。

妈妈垂头丧气地承认了她在那一刻的感受。他们逐渐意识到彼此的感受并成为恋人。

然后麻美穿上护士服，甜蜜可爱的护士生活就开始了！
